title: Among schools with an SAT excellence rate above 0.25, identify those locate
question: Among schools with an SAT excellence rate above 0.25, identify those located in counties where at least one of the two most common administrator first names appears. For these schools, compute the eligible free meal rate for students aged 5–17 and return the school name, county, and this rate, ordered from highest to lowest rate.

prediction.sql:
WITH sat_qualified AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_041 AS cds
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores sat ON s.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
    WHERE sat.XCL_036 > 0
      AND CAST(sat.XCL_040 AS REAL) / sat.XCL_036 > 0.25
),
county_top_admins AS (
    SELECT county, admin_first_name
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            s.XCL_045 AS county,
            s.XCL_080 AS admin_first_name,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.XCL_045 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
        FROM schools s
        WHERE s.XCL_080 IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY s.XCL_045, s.XCL_080
    )
    WHERE rn <= 2
)
SELECT 
    s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
    s.XCL_045 AS county,
    CAST(f.XCL_025 AS REAL) / f.XCL_024 AS free_meal_rate
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
JOIN sat_qualified sq ON s.XCL_041 = sq.cds
JOIN county_top_admins cta ON s.XCL_045 = cta.county AND s.XCL_080 = cta.admin_first_name
WHERE f.XCL_024 > 0
ORDER BY free_meal_rate DESC

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH sat_qualified AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_041 AS cds
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores sat ON s.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
    WHERE sat.XCL_036 > 0
      AND CAST(sat.XCL_040 AS REAL) / sat.XCL_036 > 0.25
),
county_top_admins AS (
    SELECT county, admin_first_name
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            s.XCL_045 AS county,
            s.XCL_080 AS admin_first_name,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.XCL_045 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
        FROM schools s
        WHERE s.XCL_080 IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY s.XCL_045, s.XCL_080
    )
    WHERE rn <= 2
)
SELECT 
    s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
    s.XCL_045 AS county,
    CAST(f.XCL_025 AS REAL) / f.XCL_024 AS free_meal_rate
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
JOIN sat_qualified sq ON s.XCL_041 = sq.cds
JOIN county_top_admins cta ON s.XCL_045 = cta.county AND s.XCL_080 = cta.admin_first_name
WHERE f.XCL_024 > 0
ORDER BY free_meal_rate DESC

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH sat_filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        s.XCL_041 AS cds,
        s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
        s.XCL_045 AS county,
        s.XCL_051 AS admin_name,
        CAST(f.XCL_020 AS REAL) / f.XCL_019 AS free_meal_rate
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
    JOIN satscores sat ON s.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
    WHERE CAST(sat.XCL_040 AS REAL) / sat.XCL_036 > 0.25
),
county_top_names AS (
    SELECT 
        county,
        admin_name,
        COUNT(*) AS name_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM sat_filtered
    GROUP BY county, admin_name
)
SELECT 
    sf.school_name,
    sf.county,
    sf.free_meal_rate
FROM sat_filtered sf
JOIN county_top_names ctn ON sf.county = ctn.county AND sf.admin_name = ctn.admin_name
WHERE ctn.rn <= 2
ORDER BY sf.free_meal_rate DESC

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    s.XCL_042 AS school_name,
    s.XCL_043 AS county,
    f.XCL_019 AS eligible_free_meal_rate
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
JOIN satscores sat ON s.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
WHERE sat.XCL_039 > 0.25
  AND s.XCL_043 IN (
    SELECT county
    FROM (
      SELECT 
          XCL_043 AS county,
          XCL_044 AS admin_first_name,
          COUNT(*) AS cnt,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY XCL_043 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
      FROM schools
      GROUP BY XCL_043, XCL_044
    )
    WHERE rn <= 2
    GROUP BY county
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT admin_first_name) >= 1
  )
ORDER BY f.XCL_019 DESC
